properties.notes: Edge of settlement location with site being occupied by a number of buildings. Brownfield in part (0.19ha) - indicative yield of around 6 dwellings appropriate for this parcel. For indicative purposes in the BF Register, the original SHLAA site (ref 1043) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.38ha. Previous proposal relating to wider site for 4 dwellings not taken forward and permission has now lapsed (N/06/B/0029). Another application for a scheme of 2 units was refused (N/06/B/0559).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
